faq.a1: 20FIT Talent is a platform connecting KOLs, photographers, and manpower with various sports events that need talent.

faq.a4: Once you apply to an event, the Event Organizer will review your profile and portfolio, then decide whether to approve or reject your application. You'll be notified of the decision via email.

faq.q6: Will I get paid for joining an event?
faq.a6: Each event has its own details — fee, schedule, location, and requirements — which you can check before applying.

pos.tpl.judge.desc: Assesses the competition at an assigned station, making sure every participant follows the rules correctly.
pos.tpl.judge.job: Judge participants at your station per the event rules, verify that reps/movements are valid, apply penalties for any violation before a participant moves to the next station, and record the results.
pos.tpl.judge.req: At least 17 years old, thorough and disciplined, able to stand in the field for long periods; prior refereeing experience not required (a briefing is given before duty).
pos.tpl.judge_hybrid.desc: Judges participants at the stations of a hybrid-race competition (a mix of running and functional movements), making sure every station runs by the rules.
pos.tpl.judge_hybrid.job: Judge and supervise participants at an assigned station per the hybrid-race format (e.g. sled push, wall ball, rowing, etc.), verify that reps/movements are valid, apply penalties for any violation, and record the results before a participant moves on to the next station.
pos.tpl.judge_hybrid.req: At least 17 years old, thorough and disciplined, able to stand and stay active throughout the shift; familiarity with functional-training / hybrid-race formats is preferred but not required.
pos.tpl.judge_running.desc: Oversees and assesses participants' compliance with the running-race rules along the route or at assigned checkpoints.
pos.tpl.judge_running.job: Monitor participants at an assigned checkpoint/post, make sure they follow the route and race rules correctly, record any violation (e.g. cutting the course) when found, and coordinate with the timing/marshal team on your observations.
pos.tpl.judge_running.req: At least 17 years old, thorough and disciplined, able to stand / stay at your post for fairly long periods; familiarity with running events is preferred but not required.
pos.tpl.runner.desc: Helps the race run smoothly along the course and between stations.
pos.tpl.runner.job: Direct participants along the course, keep the route safe and clear, help with light logistics (moving equipment between points), and respond quickly to on-site needs.
pos.tpl.runner.req: At least 15 years old, physically fit and able to move actively / walk fairly long distances while on duty; no experience required.
pos.tpl.registration_staff.desc: Helps with participant re-registration (check-in) at the event venue.
pos.tpl.registration_staff.job: Handle participant check-in, hand out race packs/gear, help participants with administrative issues, and keep the queue moving smoothly.
pos.tpl.registration_staff.req: At least 15 years old, friendly and communicative, careful when checking participant data; no experience required.
pos.tpl.water_station.desc: Staffs a water/nutrition post along the route to support participants' needs.
pos.tpl.water_station.job: Prepare and hand out water/snacks to passing participants, keep the post area clean, and make sure post supplies stay stocked.
pos.tpl.water_station.req: At least 15 years old, physically fit, able to stand / move actively for long periods; no experience required.
pos.tpl.time_chip_management.desc: Manages the participant timing system (timing chips) during the event.
pos.tpl.time_chip_management.job: Fit and collect timing chips from participants, ensure the timing system records accurately, and help troubleshoot minor technical issues in the field.
pos.tpl.time_chip_management.req: At least 17 years old, thorough and comfortable using simple technical devices; no experience required (a short briefing/training is given before duty).
pos.tpl.marshal.desc: Watches over and secures specific points along the event route.
pos.tpl.marshal.job: Guard risk points along the route (junctions, turns, crowded areas), keep participants on the correct path, and signal/inform participants and nearby vehicles.
pos.tpl.marshal.req: At least 17 years old, alert and responsive, able to stand at your post for long periods; no experience required.
pos.tpl.drop_bag.desc: Manages the safekeeping and distribution of participants' logistics bags (drop bags) during the event.
pos.tpl.drop_bag.job: Receive and log drop bags from participants at the start point, move/place drop bags to the designated pickup point, and return each drop bag to its owner accurately per the records.
pos.tpl.drop_bag.req: At least 15 years old, careful and responsible, able to lift/move items; no experience required.
pos.tpl.fotografer.desc: Documents the key moments during the event in photos.
pos.tpl.fotografer.job: Photograph participants, key moments, and the event atmosphere; edit and deliver the photos by the deadline set by the EO.
pos.tpl.fotografer.req: Own a camera (DSLR/mirrorless), have a photo portfolio (Instagram/online portfolio); event-photography experience is a plus but not required.
pos.tpl.videografer.desc: Documents the key moments during the event in video.
pos.tpl.videografer.job: Record key moments and the event atmosphere on video, then edit and deliver the video (highlight/documentation) by the deadline set by the EO.
pos.tpl.videografer.req: Own a video camera/recording gear, have a video portfolio (YouTube/Instagram/online portfolio); event-videography experience is a plus but not required.
pos.tpl.kol.desc: Creates and publishes social-media content about the event, helping with promotion and audience engagement.
pos.tpl.kol.job: Cover and create content (photo/video/story) during the event, promote the event on your personal social-media accounts, and engage with your audience/followers about the event.
pos.tpl.kol.req: Have an active social-media account (Instagram/TikTok/etc.), be used to creating content, and bring your own device (a phone with a good camera).
